summary: Steps 1 and 2 implemented in worktree thread-share, no schema change, no flag added, nothing committed/pushed/deployed. STEP 1: api/backend/interactions/thread_send.py _parse_frame now accepts shared_verse/shared_note (meta must be a dict; any non-empty attachment_key on a shared kind is rejected as bad_frame -> uniform not_allowed). After the membership/terms/key guards, the send path calls the new resolve_thread_share (api/backend/interactions/thread_shared_objects.py), which checks the chat_shared_objects flag (threads flag already checked first) and delegates to shared_objects.resolve_share, so stored attachment_meta and fallback text are server-built; ShareRejected -> not_allowed, any other failure -> send_failed (retriable), nothing stored. check_clean skips the built text for shares. Mentions on a share are rejected by existing message_mentions.validate. Live frame and push use the fallback text (push_body already labels shared kinds). threads.py history now applies html_text.clean_shared_note_meta to attachment_meta. STEP 2: new thread_note_grant in thread_shared_objects.py; SharedNoteReader.open_note (shared_objects.py) now tries the chat grant (extracted to _chat_grant, behaviour unchanged) and falls back to the thread grant via a lazy import. Thread grant requires: threads flag on for viewer, thread message exists, not soft-deleted, kind shared_note, viewer and sender both live members of the thread's group, viewer not suspended, no block pair, then the existing sender_may_share_note re-check on the note at read time; all failures return None -> the route's single uniform 404 (routes/shared_objects.py untouched). Permission rule itself unchanged (Q4 default), so no hard stop. Logs carry ids/causes only. File sizes: thread_send.py 396->415 (+19, thin call sites; under 500), shared_objects.py net +~16 from the _chat_grant extraction, threads.py +2; new logic lives in the new thread_shared_objects.py. VERIFICATION: py_compile passes on all four touched modules; pytest is not installed in this environment so the existing suites and new tests were NOT run (testing gate, step 4, owns tests and the full backend run). DOCS: not updated yet; only docs/api/chat-mentions.md references the shared kinds, and user-visible behavior is not complete until the client steps land, so docs should be updated with those (step 8).
